module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Multi-Asset Remainder Handling (Crypto with 8 Decimals vs FX with 2 Decimals)
precondition: Group trades both EURUSD (0.01 lot step) and BTCUSD (0.00000001 lot step).
expected_result: Remainder engine respects asset-specific minimum lot steps and precision scales; zero rounding error.
actual_result: Precision engine dynamically switches between 2-decimal FX step (0.01) and crypto satoshi step (1e-8).
